name: Ocal Browser v8.9.50 (Stable)
body:
OCAL BROWSER - STABLE RELEASE CATALOG
Version: 8.9.50 Stable
Release Date: September 1, 2026

===============================================================================
[FLUID HORIZONTAL & VERTICAL TABS SUITE]
===============================================================================
* MODERN FLOATING SQUIRCLE TABS: Redesigned tab items with translucent, frameless inactive states and elevated active cards with crisp typography and subtle borders.
* ADAPTIVE AUTO-SCALING & COLLAPSE: Intelligent responsive flex algorithm (180px standard down to 32px icon dock) that gracefully contracts when handling 20+ open tabs without clipping or overflowing window controls.
* ADJACENT NEW TAB BUTTON: Precision flex positioning ensuring the '+' new tab button stays immediately next to the active/last tab instead of stretching across the titlebar.
* 60FPS HARDWARE-ACCELERATED TRANSITIONS: Synchronous layout bound updates and smooth CSS opacity/max-width interpolation when toggling between Horizontal/Vertical layouts or Full/Icon Dock modes.

===============================================================================
[SECURITY OVERHAUL & INSECURE HTTP ALERTS]
===============================================================================
* DYNAMIC UNLOCK HTTP INDICATORS: Clear visual alerts for unencrypted HTTP connections with red protocol highlights (http://) and unlocked security badges.
* UNIFIED MODULAR SITE SECURITY PANEL: Real-time privacy status inspection, connection encryption breakdown, and disabled certificate warnings for HTTP sites.
* FROSTED GLASS SSL & SECURITY PAGES: Redesigned SSL warning (ssl-warning.html) and deceptive site protection (security-warning.html) with frosted glassmorphic cards, ambient glowing halos, collapsible diagnostics, and full dark/light theme sync with local assets.
* CHROME HIJACK IMMUNITY: Strict process boundaries ensuring the main window chrome (tabs, omnibox, sidebars) is never hijacked by background SSL certificate errors.

===============================================================================
[SCROLLABLE BOOKMARK BAR & WINDOW CONTROLS]
===============================================================================
* ZERO-WIDTH SCROLLABLE BOOKMARKS: Effortless horizontal mouse-wheel panning across extensive bookmark collections with cross-browser invisible scrollbars.
* APPLE-STYLE WINDOW CONTROLS: Clean traffic light window controls (Minimize, Maximize, Close) with micro-vector glyphs that reveal subtly on hover across both layout modes.

===============================================================================
[CORE ENGINE & EXTENSION UPGRADES]
===============================================================================
* ELECTRON & CHROMIUM RUNTIME: Upgraded to Electron 43.4.1 (Chromium 134 base).
* UBLOCK ORIGIN: Updated to latest release v1.74.0.
* RETURN YOUTUBE DISLIKE: Updated to v4.0.4 with fast-fail response caching.
* INNO SETUP PACKAGING: Compiled with Inno Setup 6 (LZMA2/Ultra64 compression) for ultra-fast, clean standalone installations.
